product.title: Sol Duc, Lake Crescent, and Hurricane Ridge Guided Tour in Olympic National Park

description.text: Set off on a full-day, small-group guided adventure through Olympic National Park, beginning with a scenic drive through Elwha Valley and around Lake Crescent to reach Sol Duc River Valley. Experience a guided hike to Sol Duc Falls, then explore the majestic Lake Crescent. After a stop at Port Angeles, ascend to Hurricane Ridge for breathtaking views and a guided hike through subalpine trails.

highlights: Guided hike through Washington's Sol Duc region
Spectacular views over the Olympic Mountains
Hassle-free round-trip transfers from Port Angeles
A small group means more attention from your guide
